title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Gastritis
intro: Herbal creams for Gastritis are topical ointments made from plant extracts that aim to provide relief from the symptoms of gastritis, a condition characterized by inflammation and irritation of the stomach lining. Other examples include creams made from ginger, turmeric, peppermint, and marshmallow root, each of which has its own unique properties and benefits that contribute to the relief of gastritis symptoms.
